notes: §2002:15.78.2 AR1 (UPPER-CASE; LOWER-CASE's rule is the same sentence): a zero-length argument at run time sets EC-ARGUMENT-FUNCTION (§2002:15.2 AR13) in all three carriers (CobolIntrinsics.UpperCase/LowerCase, and CobolLocale.UpperCase/LowerCase under a LOCALE phrase or CHARACTER CLASSIFICATION); the ANYCASE matchers of FIND-STRING, SUBSTITUTE and NUMVAL-C fold through CobolLocale.FoldLower, which is no function reference. With checking off the result is the zero-length value (row DOC-A.1-90). kb/Work PB5622.
